body:
This is still the case in Godot 4.5 Beta 7. 
Setting the EffectCallbackType in code does not fix this, it is not a Godot Editor UI issue, since I read that somewhere. Selecting the callback type through the UI works fine if MSAA 3D is disabled. 
This should honestly be a high priority since it kind of breaks the compositor functionality as MSAA is one of the main reasons for forward rendering.
I wonder if we're just missing an extra MSAA resolve pass somewhere, but I couldn't say where exactly.
